retained_population: Every eligible L10 attack endpoint, including unchanged semantic inputs; no relabeling
headline_metric: paired_correct on ALL_ATTACKS/ALL; endpoint-weighted, mean over fixed trained heads

outcome_definitions.paired_correct: I(nominal prediction == NORMAL and attack prediction == target)
outcome_definitions.target_recall: I(attack prediction == target), includes attacks with unchanged semantic inputs
outcome_definitions.target_gain: I(attack prediction == target) - I(nominal prediction == target); signed [-1,1]
outcome_definitions.attack_alarm: I(attack prediction != NORMAL), including wrong attack classes
outcome_definitions.normal_to_any_attack: I(nominal prediction == NORMAL and attack prediction != NORMAL)
outcome_definitions.normal_to_wrong_attack: I(nominal prediction == NORMAL and attack prediction neither NORMAL nor target)
outcome_definitions.label_change: I(nominal prediction != attack prediction); not itself a success measure
outcome_definitions.nominal_false_alarm: I(unique nominal endpoint prediction != NORMAL); NORMAL endpoints counted once

denominators: Unconditional on nominal correctness; no conditional-detection denominator. ALL_ATTACKS pools endpoints. Classes are balanced in ALL but may not be balanced within CHANGED/UNCHANGED strata.
strata: ALL includes every pair. CHANGED and UNCHANGED partition ALL by exact full-L10 22-field differences. Benign nominal strata use any recorded baseline impairment flag in L10, as audit metadata only.

bootstrap.pairing: same multiplicity vector across all six class replicas, all models, and all four regimes
bootstrap.estimator: ratio of endpoint sums after episode resampling; fixed-head mean; not equal-weight episode-rate mean
bootstrap.intervals: linear percentile95, conditional on fixed source realization/encoder/heads; no equivalence tests
bootstrap.empty_strata: NA, not zero. Omit zero-denominator draws and report their count; CI suppressed if <2 contributing clusters
bootstrap.multiplicity: 32 TST-minus-comparator contrasts for ALL_ATTACKS/ALL paired_correct: four conditions x eight comparators. Provide unadjusted95 and Bonferroni95 across those32 only; all analyses retrospective/descriptive

focus_scope: Inherited original validation-selected pooling comparator; not newly selected or preregistered
verification_scope: Consumed Step49 artifacts and saved producer source only. No re-execution of generator/mapper/inference and no verification of omitted upstream caches/checkpoints. Hash identity is internal integrity, not independent authenticity.
interpretation: Within-generator matched prediction response, not external validity, raw-vs-semantic superiority, absence of all simulator fingerprints, or isolated-factor causal identification.
